algorithm.Title: Poison Ivy - Oak - Sumac - Female (Child)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Child | Female
Definition: Qatar-localized UAT-only adult and pediatric pathway for suspected plant contact dermatitis, screening for anaphylaxis, eye/mucosal exposure, widespread blistering, infection and immune risk; not approved for production.
FirstAid: Call Qatar 999 and do not drive. Keep the patient lying unless breathing is difficult; use only their prescribed adrenaline auto-injector according to its plan and dispatcher instructions. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Are throat or tongue swelling, breathing difficulty, faintness, confusion, or collapse the main concern?
questions.Information: Systemic allergic-reaction features require the Anaphylaxis pathway.

questions.Question: Is there sudden swelling of the lips, mouth, throat, or tongue, or difficulty breathing along with the rash?
questions.Information: Universal emergency rule-out added ahead of the contact dermatitis guidance itself - severe allergic swelling or breathing difficulty requires immediate care, distinct from typical contact dermatitis.

questions.Question: Are symptoms persistent, recurrent, or severe, or has the triggering substance not responded to treatment?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance: arrange clinical review through a Qatar pathway approved by governance (GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED) for persistent, recurrent, or severe contact dermatitis symptoms.

questions.Question: Is this a mild, typical case with none of the features above?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance: a pharmacist can recommend emollients (moisturisers) for mild contact dermatitis.

advice.Title: Emergency allergic reaction precautions
Content: Call Qatar 999 and do not drive. Keep the patient lying unless breathing is difficult; use only their prescribed adrenaline auto-injector according to its plan and dispatcher instructions. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: breathing worsens; swelling spreads or consciousness reduces.

advice.Title: Contact dermatitis follow-up
Content: Arrange in-person primary-care review through the Qatar pathway approved for UAT to confirm the cause and assess whether dermatology input is needed.
Call Back If: symptoms worsen; not improving with treatment.

advice.Title: Review for suspected plant dermatitis
Content: Avoid further exposure, gently wash exposed skin and contaminated clothing, and arrange clinician/pharmacist review before creams or medicines are selected. Do not burn suspected plants because smoke exposure may be hazardous.
Call Back If: rash worsens, spreads, blisters or becomes infected; eye, mouth, breathing or systemic symptoms.
